acceptance: A cell run with dropped reports gives an incomplete read signal, not a clean one, proven by a unit test
A host test shows a canary report for a normal cell run
fix: Use the gate canary pattern of sandbox (CanaryStart, CanaryEnd, rule gate.canary): the cell reads a tagged canary, and a missing canary report marks the read incomplete.
summary: On 2026-11-11 the kernel logged no sandbox report of a newly built binary while AMFI checked its ad-hoc signature, but the fence from cat (a platform binary) still showed. bridge.reportReadViolations trusts the same fence, so a cell whose reports were dropped looks clean at I5 shadow.
title: Bridge read isolation proves report delivery with a report of the cell, not only a fence
